body:
Chat Isolation
This client-side mod minimizes distractions to help you focus during high-stakes cPvP drain and tierlist fights. It blocks all chat and server messages except your opponent's, your own, and necessary updates (rekit, regear, or heal).

Features
Opponent Whitelisting: Lock your focus on your opponent while blocking out surrounding chatter from spectators or unrelated players.
Smart System & Broadcast Filtering: Blocks server/system messages unless they explicitly reference you or one of your whitelisted opponents. This keeps you informed of critical events (such as opponent rekitting, regearing, or healing) without unnecessary server logs/clutter.
Persistent Configuration: Automatically saves and loads your preferences and whitelisted players 

Command	Description

/chat isolation on	             Enables the isolation filter.

/chat isolation off              Disables the isolation filter (displays all chat).

/chat isolation add <player>	 Adds a player (opponent) to the whitelist.

/chat isolation remove <player>	 Removes a player from the whitelist.

/chat isolation list	         Displays all currently whitelisted players.

/chat isolation clear	         Clears the entire whitelist.
